status: inputs of the PROPOSED V4 packet; authorizes nothing; V4 GPU execution is NO GO
purpose: profiler lifecycle scaling and operational safety at twice the V3 size. Not scientific identification: the eight waves are replicates of two accepted cells within one session.
changes: workload.frontend.path -> traces/e1_v4_scale.csv (the accepted 56 rows 4 times; copy i has wave index i and +i x 80 s)

expected.basis: 4 x the V2 measurement of the same 56 rows. Kernel rows per wave were identical in V2, V3 wave 0 and V3 wave 1 (b=8: 5 887 244, b=48: 6 363 588), so this is a prediction from repeated measurements of the same cells, not an extrapolation in trace content

predictions.source: feasibility/E1-SCALING-MODEL.md, column 'intermediate ~49 M': min - max over three curves through the V2 and V3 points, then the stress case

supervisor.control_line: release-gpus V4 resource-limit abort (registered supervisor response)
supervisor.latch: release line at most once; registry cleanup at most once and final; never concurrent; the reservation guard is acted on in every state (directly, or as an escalation after an earlier release request)

reservation.launch_rule: eligible iff supervisor_guard_s - age >= run_budget_total_s, evaluated by the driver (checks/e1_reservation_guard.py eligible) before any observer or the launcher is started; refusal exit 7

closeout.watcher: watch: on the capture tray, registry pids/closeout.tsv, this host's read-only credential; permits the deletion, observes it, writes reservation_closeout.json; never deletes, never signals
closeout.deleter: delete: on the operator's laptop, own registry, the deleting credential; one DELETE with the recorded UID as precondition after two consecutive permits and its own ownership check; writes reservation_deleted.json
closeout.record: record: reservation.json from kubectl with the deleting credential, with a dry-run proof that the UID precondition is honoured; the driver refuses to start without it, without the live pod matching it, or without the watcher and the deleter armed (exit 5, 8)
permit_conditions: D1 the run's registry has no live owned process and no refusal (the run has ENDED: no early release)
D2 no process that looks like the experiment is outside every registry
D3 two consecutive pinned GPU censuses: no compute process, memory within the idle bound on every GPU
D4 the live pod is exactly the recorded reservation: name, namespace, UID, creation time, this node, labels, pause containers only, GPU request
closeout.not_a_condition: a live importer or Nsight agent (recorded; they hold no GPU and are never signalled)
closeout.gate: G16.reservation_deletion (checks/e1_v4scale_gates.py): FAIL unless both records say DELETED_IN_TIME for the recorded UID, the permit precedes the delete request and both observations are within the ceiling

measured_v3.note: the 832 s were operator time without a deadline (closeout 5.6 min after the stop file, deletion requested 7.2 min after the closeout); in V4 the watcher and the deleter act without an operator inside the 720 s budget

early_release_after_verified_gpu_release.note: designed and CPU-tested only (checks/e1_reservation_release.py); not authorized

memory_budget.server_allowance_basis: everything the run holds when the importer starts (server, engine, workers, launcher, Nsight CLI and agent): MemAvailable before the launch minus MemAvailable at the stop request, measured in V3 as 858.0 - 562.8 = 295.2 GiB (285 GiB steady after load; 306 GiB transient during load, when no importer exists); 320 GiB leaves 24.8 GiB above that measurement for growth over the longer V4 capture (V3 grew 9.3 GiB between warm-up and the stop request; about 5 GiB more is projected for V4's further 160 s) and for other consumers on the node
memory_budget.review: review decisions of 2026-11-19: on 39561325 preflight minimum 448 -> 488 GiB; on 76d95289 488 -> 512 GiB. Runtime floor 64 GiB, importer ceiling 128 GiB and every breach response unchanged

ceilings.memory_basis: GiB (1024^3 B). Importer ceiling 128 GiB and runtime floor 64 GiB unchanged from V3; preflight minimum 512 GiB = ceiling + floor + 320 GiB for the run (V3 measured 295.2 GiB at the stop request; earlier proposals: 448 GiB assumed 256 GiB, 488 GiB assumed 296 GiB)
ceilings.storage_basis: review decision of 2026-11-19 on 598d4a2d: temporary 15 GB, run directory 18 GB, run directory plus archive 38 GB
